description: Lists venues and IDs, with each venue's area. For a user who names where they are, pass near: venues come nearest first with distance_km. Cines Unidos requires city or near; Supercines accepts an optional city; Cinepic verifies its configured venues Candelaria and VVIP Lido. Providers keep known venues without a verified code (code_status=unverified). Cinex accepts an optional city and includes known venues missing from the current directory (directory_status=not_listed); neither condition indicates a closure.

city.description: City name as returned by list_cities for the same provider (e.g. Caracas); accents and case are ignored for Cines Unidos.

near.description: Where the user is: a neighbourhood or town (Chacao, Las Mercedes, Naguanagua, Lechería) or "lat,lng". Sorts venues nearest first and adds distance_km; with it Cines Unidos needs no city.

provider.description: Cinema provider; get its capabilities and limitations with list_providers.

query.description: Filters by name, ignoring accents and case.

refresh.description: true: queries the provider without the local cache and requests HTTP revalidation. Does not guarantee that the provider has updated its content.

name: list_cinemas

area.description: Neighbourhood and municipality or town of the venue (Chacao; Las Mercedes, Baruta), from Cinve's venue locations; absent for a venue Cinve has not located.

code_status.description: Code confirmed by the current official data; unverified does not imply a closure.

directory_status.description: Presence in the directory received in this query; not_listed does not imply a closure.

distance_km.description: Straight-line distance in km from the place given in near; not a travel distance.

id.description: Venue ID. directory-* identifies an entry without a queryable code; if code_status is present, use cinema_id only when it is verified.

title: List venues
